_readme: The test: Snare and wait, Iron, The second past, Jab, Breaker's yard, Lucky penny, Spreads, Arc, map:lie_of_the_land, map:relay, pick:kennel/a_dog, ring:damage, region:petrol, region:the_codes, backdrop:dial, portrait:scrapper. Judge these before the rest runs.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a square of wire-mesh trap on four pegs, a trail of grain leading in. One object centred and filling the frame, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon. Muted cool northern palette, worn, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, no numbers, a transparent background.

jobs.description: Pixel art, a flat surface seen straight on, filling the whole frame edge to edge with no border, no frame, no vignette, no horizon: a radio operator's dark baize table top under a desk lamp's dim pool, a faint ring from a mug, worn to the weave at the edges. Very dark and even, low contrast, muted blue-grey and slate palette with a warm amber tinge at the centre; a chart of lines and small discs is drawn on top of this, so nothing in it may stand out - no single object, no bright patch, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no people.
jobs._where: the dial canvas's backdrop, drawn x2 under the web

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of the Scrapper, a lean wiry man in his thirties who builds guns out of anything: a shaved head with a welder's burn on the scalp, a thick stubbled jaw, a filthy orange hi-vis vest over a torn grey hoodie, a nail gun's strap across his chest, grease to the elbows, a quick sharp look. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, overcast light. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.
jobs._where: the Scrapper's face, a new look (parked from the playtest, 21 Oct)
